title: The Angry Birds Movie but it's ruined by AI
original_title: The Angry Birds Movie but it's ruined by AI
overview: A chaotic, AI-generated reimagining of the beloved animated world where nothing makes sense anymore. In this digital fever dream, classic characters experience bizarre glitches, existential crises, and corrupted dialogue. From birds forgetting what they are doing mid-flight to nonsensical "limited edition skin" upgrades and a delivery service gone horribly wrong (resulting in a bird getting trapped under a house foundation), the flightless birds find themselves trapped in a broken simulation where anger is replaced by forced happiness.
